title: Mr. L. Imas - Complaints

page_data.en:
Miscellaneous File No. 243/39.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date July 21, 1939.
Subject Reference attached containing complaints of a Mr. L. Ims.
Made by. D.S.I. Tuck, Forwarded by.
Sir,
During the morning of the 17/7/39 a telephone communication was received by the undersigned from Chief Inspector Hall of the S.M.P. Headquarters Traffic Department, reporting to the effect that a foreigner by the name of Ims was present inside the traffic office and making himself a nuisance by his persistent requests for assistance in connection with numerous offences of larceny including the theft of a M/truck and assaults which had already been reported to Hongkew Station and investigated, but the results not having been favourable to himself the foreigner had hoped to obtain satisfaction by demanding the assistance of the above office.
As no assistance could be rendered by the above office it was suggested that the foreigner concerned be referred to this station the undersigned having undertaken to personally investigate his complaints.
At about 11 a.m. 17/7/39, the foreigner concerned attended this station his particulars being:-
Mr. L. Ims of Rumanian nationality, sole proprietor of The Shanghai Express Delivery Service, of Apt. 50, No.153 Route des Soeurs, French Concession, who when asked to state his complaints, claimed that a number of offences had been committed against him by persons residing at House 20E, Lane 57 Thorne Road, which premises he occupies and uses as a godown for storing luggage obtained in connection with his transportation concern.

虹口巡捕房，
报告
日期：1939年7月21日。
事由：关于附函所涉 L. Ims 先生的投诉。
呈报人：副督察长塔克（Tuck），转呈人：
敬启者：
1939年7月17日上午，卑职接到上海公共租界工部局警务处总部交通科霍尔（Hall）总督察的电话通报，称一名名为 Ims 的外国人出现在交通科办公室内，因其不断要求协助处理多起盗窃案（包括一辆摩托卡车被盗）及袭击案而滋扰办公；上述案件此前已向虹口巡捕房报案并经过调查，但因结果未如其愿，该外国人试图通过向上述部门施压以求得满意之结果。
鉴于上述部门无法提供协助，建议将该外国人引荐至本巡捕房，卑职已承诺亲自调查其投诉。
1939年7月17日上午11时许，该外国人来到本巡捕房，其个人资料如下：
L. Ims 先生，罗马尼亚籍，系“上海快递服务”（The Shanghai Express Delivery Service）独资经营者，住址为法租界姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）153号50室。当其被要求陈述投诉内容时，他声称位于汤姆生路（Thorne Road）57弄20E号的住所内居住的人员对其犯下多项罪行，该处所由其占用，并用作存放与其运输业务相关的行李的仓库。

These alleged offences, which included, theft of
various articles of furniture from the address, theft of
petrol and malicious damage to tyres and inner tubes of
the M/trucks and assaults upon himself by inmates of
this address, who have occupied same without his per-
mission, have all been reported at various times to this
station, D.S.I. Beloshenko or D.S. Fedoroff having
investigated, but in each and every instance he had not
received correct treatment or obtained satisfaction as
some of the cases were alleged refused investigation.
D.S.I. Beloshenko and D.S. Fedoroff were each
questioned concerning the above allegations, when it was
learned that Mr. J. Ims is a very wilful and vindictive
minded person and inclined to grossly prevaricate and
exaggerate incidents involving himself, in order that
the persons against whom his complaints are directed will
be punished as severely as possible and thus he desires
to obtain satisfaction. Complaints and offences recorded
and investigated are as follows:-
On the 20/1/39, the complainant attended Hongkew
Station and made a report that a number of persons were
residing inside his premises No.57/20 Thorne Road without
his permission, some of whom were criminals and others
prostitutes, therefore he demanded their immediate
eviction. The Complainant's complaints not being
substantiated in any manner whatsoever he was advised to
obtain assistance from the S.S.D.Court regarding their
eviction if he still required same. (Entered Occurrence Book)

这些所谓罪行包括从该地址盗窃各种家具、盗窃汽油、恶意损坏摩托卡车的轮胎和内胎，以及该地址内未经其许可擅自居住的住户对其实施的袭击。上述事件曾多次向本巡捕房报案，由副督察长别洛申科（Beloshenko）或警佐费多罗夫（Fedoroff）进行调查，但在每一次调查中，他都未得到公正对待或获得满意结果，因为据称有些案件被拒绝调查。
就上述指控分别询问了副督察长别洛申科和警佐费多罗夫，得知 J. Ims 先生是一个极其任性且怀有报复心理的人，倾向于严重歪曲和夸大涉及自身的事件，以便使其投诉对象受到尽可能严厉的惩罚，从而求得心理满足。记录在案并经调查的投诉及罪行如下：
1939年1月20日，投诉人前往虹口巡捕房报案，称有多人未经许可居住在其位于汤姆生路57/20号的 premises（处所）内，其中一些人是罪犯，另一些是妓女，因此他要求立即将他们驱逐。由于投诉人的指控毫无事实依据，警方建议他若仍希望驱逐这些人，应向特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）寻求协助。（已录入事故登记簿）

During the 25/2/39 an exactly similar complaint
was made with like results. (Entered Occurrence Book).
At about 5 p.m. 9/4/39, (Russian Easter) Mr. Imas
came to the Station and reported that three metal bath
tubs and a quantity of metal piping had been stolen from
the compound of No.57/20 Thorne Road and alleged the
inmates of the address responsible for the offence.
Dets. Beloshenko and No. 10 investigated the matter
and ascertained that the bath tubs had been removed from
an address at Haskell Road, formerly occupied by Mr. L.
Imas, but just after the commencement of the recent
hostilities the premises was burnt down and completely
gutted, however the complainant was able to collect the
metal property concerned and have it deposited outside
neighbouring premises to No.57/20 Thorne Road; this
address being occupied by a Japanese family. To these
articles appeared nothing more or less than scrap metal,
the male Japanese tenant had repeatedly informed Imas
to have the rubbish removed if he was the owner of same
and prevent the alleyway from being cluttered up, even-
tually threatening to employ some persons to dump the
stuff concerned in the Hongkew Creek just to get rid of
it. After this property had remained there for about one
year it disappeared and the report of the disappearance
was not made to the Station until the elapse of some
considerable time, which was selected to be Russian
Easter, when Mr. Imas alleged that the residents at the
address No.57/20 Thorne Road were making merry and

1939年4月9日下午5时许（俄罗斯复活节），Imas 先生来到巡捕房，报案称汤姆生路57/20号大院内三个金属浴缸和一批金属管道被盗，并指控该地址的住户为此负责。
侦探别洛申科和第10号警员对此事进行了调查，查明这些浴缸是从哈斯克尔路（Haskell Road）的一处地址搬走的，该处以前由 L. Imas 先生占用，但在最近战事刚开始不久，该房屋被烧毁并彻底焚毁；然而，投诉人能够收集到相关的金属财产，并将其堆放在汤姆生路57/20号邻近处所的外部；该地址由一个日本家庭占用。对于这些物品，看起来不过是废金属，日本男房客曾反复告知 Imas，如果他是这些物品的所有者，请将垃圾清理掉，以免堵塞巷道，甚至威胁要雇人将这些东西倒入虹口港以摆脱它们。在这些财产存放约一年后，它们消失了，但失踪报告直到相当长一段时间后才向巡捕房提出，特意选在俄罗斯复活节这一天，当时 Imas 先生指控汤姆生路57/20号地址的居民正在寻欢作乐，

    Prior to the above report Mr. L. Imas had been
to the Station and requested D.S.I. Beloshenko to evict

    在上述报案之前，L. Imas 先生曾前往巡捕房，请求副督察长别洛申科将这些人从该处所驱逐，每次均被告知应前往特区地方法院（S/S.D. Court），因为上海公共租界工部局警务处无权驱逐这些人；因此，在经过适当查询且未获得证实盗窃指控的证据后，认为 L. Imas 的真实意图仅仅是将这些人从该处所驱逐，因为在俄罗斯复活节，该国籍的所有人通常都会庆祝这一节日，互相分享酒食，因此他故意提出此报告，至少给处境非常贫困的相关人员造成尴尬和不便，

abusive to an employee a Mr. S.T. Lensky, Russian, which

辱骂了一名雇员 S.T. Lensky 先生（俄罗斯人），这随后导致对 Lensky 先生提出盗窃指控，进而引发争吵，随后双方互殴，导致双方均受轻伤。起初，袭击报告是针对汤姆生路57/20号的所有住户提出的，逐一指名道姓地提及了居住在那里的每个人，但在调查完成并将结果告知 L. Imas 先生后，他承认为了支持他在中央巡捕房对 S. T. Lensky 先生提出的挪用指控，他夸大了案情。在相关巡捕房进行的查询证实，投诉人曾多次提出类似性质的指控，但在每种情况下，因缺乏证实指控的证据而被拒绝调查。

    此次，L. Imas 先生被告知，如果他对调查结果不满意，且警方不再采取进一步行动，建议他在特区地方法院（S.S.) Court）对肇事者提起私人刑事起诉，（据悉此类起诉已经提起）。

    关于上述投诉，本巡捕房于1939年7月13日收到一封信函，该信致警察总监，日期为1939年7月7日，由 L. Imas 签署。（信函附后）。

    这封信简要列出了上述盗窃事件及事故，并指出已接触副督察长别洛申科

has been approached in order to have the persons whom

In view of the above and to appease or give
satisfaction to the complainant that these matters had
been fully investigated, D.S. Fedoroff and the under-
signed accompanied by Mr. Imae proceeded to House No.20,
Lane 57 Wharne Road, and found it to be a large two
storied Chinese styled dwelling house, having a total

Each occupant of a room pays a monthly rental
of between $17.00 and $20.00, thus the total rent that
will be collected for this month will approximate
$130.00.
Mr. Imae insisted in the presence of these
tenants that he has never given permission for them to
reside on the premises, and that they entered during
his absence whilst he was absent attending to his
transportation business, and since then they have failed
to leave the premises.
The inmates when questioned explained that
Mr. J. Imae does not reside on the premises, but has
allowed them to occupy certain rooms at an agreed
rental, this money being collected by a male Chinese
named Zau Ah Chang (趙阿祥), who is employed during the
day by the complainant to work as coolie on one of the
m/trucks whilst in use in connection with the transpor-
tation business, during the night-times he is allowed to

鉴于上述情况，并为安抚投诉人或使其相信这些事项已得到充分调查，警佐费多罗夫和卑职在 Imae 先生的陪同下前往华恩路（Wharne Road）57弄20号，发现这是一栋大型两层中式住宅，共有九个房间，其中七个目前由贫困的外国家庭或个人占用。
每个房间的住户每月支付租金17.00元至20.00元不等，因此本月收取的总租金约为130.00元。
Imae 先生在这些租户面前坚持声称，他从未允许他们居住在该处所，他们是趁他不在处理运输业务时进入的，此后他们一直未离开该处所。
当被问及此事时，住户解释说 J. Imae 先生并不居住在该处所，而是允许他们以商定的租金占用某些房间，这笔钱由一名叫赵阿祥（Zau Ah Chang）的中国男子收取，此人白天受雇于投诉人，在运输业务使用的其中一辆摩托卡车上担任苦力，夜间则被允许

在 premises（房产）内住宿，获免费提供一个小房间，条件是他每月代收租金，并将租金交给投诉人，同时向苦力开具收据，苦力随即将收据转交相关人员。
    调查此案的侦探查阅了一系列均由 L. 先生签名的此类收据副本。
    F. Richter 先生，南斯拉夫籍，受雇为乐师，系虹口分局 N.I.S. 第447/39号案件中的投诉人，已在该房产内居住一年多，每月支付租金20.00美元。
    S. I. Lensky 先生，白俄罗斯籍，截至1939年7月6日的九个月期间，受雇于投诉人担任卡车司机，月薪90.00美元。由于 Lensky 先生及其妻子在上述地址获提供房间，约定租金为20.00美元，该款项通常被视为从工资中扣除，但实际上 Lensky 先生从未在任何一个月领到约定的全额工资，有时从投诉人处仅收到低至35.00美元的款项，因此导致投诉人频繁对 Lensky 先生进行滋扰和指控，这显然是作为一种手段，胁迫他接受任何被提供的工资数额。
    其他已出租的房间租期较短，但均有约定的租金。

One ground floor room, entirely separated from
the others is used as a godown, for storing bags, boxes
and trunks, it being heavily boarded up and with a thick
metal cross-bar over the centre of the door, which is
secured by a strong lock and hasp, so it is impossible
for any person to gain entrance without the key to the
lock or strong instruments with which to prise the wood
or cross-bar from the doors or windows, therefore the
complainant's report of jeopardizing the safety of the
articles stored there is rather exaggerated. At the
time of this visit there was three medium sized trunks
in this godown and a considerable quantity of rubbish,
lengths of wood and paper, etc., the godown would
hardly enable the storage of baggage to the extent of
some tens of thousands of dollars as averred in the
letter.

Damaged inner tubes of a M/Truck were produced,
but it is very evident that they are in a very old
state, caused through continuous wear and usage, the
rents or tears being very irregular and definitely not
the result of an instrument used maliciously to cause
the damage.

As for the theft of petrol and the M/Truck no
proof was available to substantiate such allegations as
the M/Truck referred to is used by the complainant to
transport merchandise and baggage to the interior and is
at present being used for such a purpose.

底层有一间与其他房间完全隔开的房间用作仓库，用于存放袋子、箱子和皮箱，门窗用厚木板封死，门中央装有粗金属横杠，并用坚固的锁和搭扣锁住，因此若无钥匙或使用强力工具撬开门窗的木板或横杠，任何人无法进入，故投诉人关于存放在此的物品安全受到威胁的报告略显夸张。在此次查访时，该仓库内有三个中等大小的皮箱以及大量垃圾、木条和纸张等，该仓库几乎不可能如信中所述存放价值数万美元的行李。

出示了一辆卡车的损坏内胎，但很明显这些内胎因长期磨损和使用而处于非常陈旧的状态，裂口或破洞极不规则，绝非恶意使用工具造成损坏的结果。

至于汽油和卡车被盗一事，并无证据证实此类指控，因为所涉卡车正由投诉人用于向内地运输货物和行李，目前也正用于此目的。

stated that he has obtained a lease from Mr. Payne
employed by Igar & Co., com '06 Amoy House, Jinkoo
Road, also an inventory of the articles of furniture left
behind by the original Chinese owner who vacated the
residence at the outbreak of the recent hostilities, some
of which have allegedly been stolen.

The complainant was asked to produce the lease
and inventory, in order that same may be checked, but
he has failed to do so.

Enquiries made of Igar & Co. ascertained that
the complainant does possess a lease for the premises,
which lease was commenced February 1938 with a monthly
rental of $30.00.

From the above it is fairly apparent that the
complainant now realising the increased demand for rooms
and also the high rentals that can be asked for, has
mainly caused these reports to be made to the Station in
the hope that the present occupants will be evicted, he
then can operate a foreign styled boarding house, at a
very much increased rental and thus benefit greatly over
his present endeavours in that line.

In view of the foregoing it is very obvious that
Mr. Payne is an exceptionally unpleasant and obnoxious
person, being desirous only of benefiting himself. He

要求投诉人出示租约和清单以便核查，但他未能做到。

经向 Igar & Co. 查询，确认投诉人确实持有该房产的租约，该租约始于1938年2月，月租金为30.00美元。

综上所述，相当明显的是，投诉人如今意识到房间需求增加且可索取高额租金，主要是出于希望驱逐现有住户的目的才向分局提交这些报告，以便他能够经营一家西式寄宿公寓，收取高得多的租金，从而在此类业务中获得比目前大得多的利益。

会采取极端手段，例如只要有一丝可能使自己获益，便提出虚假指控；如果他制造的混乱越多，且其企图未受挫败，他就越感到满足。因此，对于他写给上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的任何信件、电报或报告，都应极为谨慎地对待，因为他可能会轻率地将他人卷入可能的严重困境中。
